description: Allowlist for public repo export — defaults to DENY unless explicitly listed (allowlist pattern, not denylist)

rules.comment: Application source code — core product logic
Database schema migrations — structure only, no seed data
Public assets — images, fonts, static files
GitHub workflows and CI/CD (enforcement layer allowed per G-6)

blocked.comment: Always blocked — business documents, strategy, financial data

automatedFilters.name: filename-blacklist
automatedFilters.description: Second-layer defense: files containing blocked keywords in path

automatedFilters.name: secret-scan
automatedFilters.description: Third-layer defense: detects API keys, tokens, credentials via pattern scanning

automatedFilters.name: pii-scan
automatedFilters.description: Fourth-layer defense: uses guardian.ts patterns to detect PII

approvalGates.name: workflow-dispatch
approvalGates.description: Triggered only via GitHub UI, never automatic

approvalGates.name: required-reviewers
approvalGates.description: Requires human approval from production-public-sync environment

branchProtection.description: Public repo has no direct push — only bot token via workflow

auditLogging.description: Private repo maintains immutable log of all syncs
